item.title: GovBrief Today #597
item.description: Iran-backed Houthis fired a ballistic missile at Riyadh today, three days after Donald Trump said "hopefully we're toward the end" of the war. Saudi Arabia says it shot the missile down. By evening, American embassies in nine countries were warning citizens that airspace across the region could close, and the State Department said the fighting could escalate rapidly. Iran says Qatar has delivered its terms for ending the war to the United States and that it is waiting on Trump's answer. He cut his weekend at Camp David short and returned to Washington. 15. Big up to every fellow indie dev who still don't use AI in their games. P.S. Next few lines are going to be a long read, so if you don't feel like it, skip. I just wanted to share that I'm also making a game of mine. It's been difficult and and took me almost a year to get the demo out and now things have started to happen, for example my demo still holds 100% positive reviews and I've been approached by two publishers (not sure if I want to work with them). The game is a psychological horror/trolley problem style game inspired by The Milgram Experiment. As always I avoid using generative AI. Which means all script is written by humans, the voice acting is done by humans, the assets, everything. If that game is something you migh like, feel free to wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2719670/The_Milgram_Experiment/

item.title: Mark Carney Mimics Trump's Hand Gestures in Ottawa Speech

The playful imitation came amid his push for closer EU ties on energy and defense, despite Trump's warning that it could be a hostile act.
